claim_text: Algal oils can provide preformed long-chain omega-3 fatty acids, particularly DHA and in some products EPA; vegan status and low fish intake alone do not establish a universal need for supplementation, so product composition and current intake must be reviewed.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsupported supplementation and support context-specific evidence interpretation.

population.other_context: Vegan adults with low or no oily-fish intake; assess dietary pattern, fortified foods and current supplements.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food sources and relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Omega-3 fact sheet describes algal oils as a source of omega-3s and differentiates EPA/DHA sources.
limitations: Products vary in EPA/DHA composition; no dose or clinical outcome is inferred.
Underlying evidence and exact source passages require full appraisal before approval.
